ns2:course.label: Eastern Europe
ns2:course.description: The political, economic, and cultural history of Poland, Czechoslovakia, Hungary, Rumania, Yugoslavia, Bulgaria, Greece, and Albania; particular emphasis upon the post-World War II era. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One year of college history or consent of instructor.
